examples.english: Four teams compete in the semifinals.

notes:
{準決勝|じゅんけっしょう} is the round before the finals, with winners advancing to the championship match.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {準決勝|じゅんけっしょう}に{進|すす}む (to advance to semifinals)
- {準決勝|じゅんけっしょう}に{進出|しんしゅつ}する (to reach semifinals)
- {準決勝|じゅんけっしょう}で{敗退|はいたい}する (to be eliminated in semifinals)
- {準決勝|じゅんけっしょう}{第|だい}1{戦|せん} (first semifinal match)

TOURNAMENT STRUCTURE:
{準決勝|じゅんけっしょう} typically has 4 teams/players:
- A vs B → 勝者 advances to 決勝
- C vs D → 勝者 advances to 決勝
